component.name: GaugeDeck
component.summary: Car-style gauges for your PC's temps, fans and load

description.p: GaugeDeck shows your computer's vital signs as a dashboard of car-style dials: CPU temperature and load, GPU temperature and fan, system fans, RAM use and board temperature.
Alerts warn you with a notification, an alarm sound and a flashing gauge when a temperature stays too high or a fan stops spinning.

It is a native GTK 4 app, so it works on current GNOME Wayland desktops where desktop widgets such as Conky no longer display or can freeze the session. Sensors are detected automatically for Intel and AMD processors and common motherboard chips. It only reads sensor values and changes nothing on the system.
Temperature and power gauges for an NVIDIA compute card running next to an AMD or Intel display card, with a temperature alert.
Test alert also flashes a gauge for 10 seconds.
Alerts: notification, alarm sound and flashing gauge for high temperatures, high memory use and stopped fans.
Installer now installs python3-gi-cairo; clearer error if it is missing.
Fan gauges use the machine's own fan names when available.
